policy: PokéAPI supplies source-derived facts. The six default level-up evolution rules introduced in Ruby/Sapphire are explicitly mapped to Emerald for this roster. Only default forms are selected. Types/stats/abilities use the nearest historical generation endpoint at or after generation 3. Moves rewind changelog entries after Emerald, with the generation-3 type-based damage class. Natures apply to Emerald. No independent ROM validation has been performed.
gaps: Progression gates, starter choice restrictions, breeding/trade routes, item shops/ground gifts, tutor access and complete move/ability effects are not reviewed. Encounter rows establish methods and levels, not current reachability. Held-item acquisitions derive only from Emerald wild encounters and exact-version held-item records.
